name: Don't Take the Brainrot
desc:
Don't get caught by the Brainrots !! 😮😁

Sneak around and take brainrots without getting caught! 🥷
Escape when you are being chased by the Brainrots ! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many brainrots as possible! ⚡

If you're having fun, remember to hit the thumbs up! 👍

*If you run into bugs, report them below 👇*
